assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 MaviGadget 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方／创作者：谁在运营该频道？
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别。
  7. 内容供应模式。
  8. 代表作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，MaviGadget 排名第 33 名，历史累计观看量约为 63B（630 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 MaviGadget 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml: MaviGadget is a U.S.-based product-discovery media brand operating a high-volume YouTube Shorts channel, ranked #33 in the United States and approximately #140 globally by subscribers as of September 2, 2026 (Communitrics snapshot).

evidence.snippet: Channel page confirms Channel ID UCJfNJmcv6LXCDsaa2kB_-7A, handle @MaviGadgets, 46M subscribers, 12K videos. YouTube About page snippet shows 'Joined Nov 19, 2017' and total views 63.5B.
evidence.supports: Stable channel ID, canonical URL, handle, subscriber count, creation date (Nov 19, 2017), and total views.

evidence.snippet: Created On: Nov 19, 2017. Subscribers: 46M, Views: 64B, Videos: 13K. Monthly estimated earnings $263K-$4.2M.
evidence.supports: Channel creation date confirmed; view/subscriber scale corroborated.

evidence.snippet: Ahmet Yanik — Founder at Mavigadget (Oct 2016 - Present), Brandimi (Sep 2014 - Present), Chicago, Illinois, United States.
evidence.supports: Operator/creator is Ahmet Yanik, founder of MaviGadget and Brandimi LLC, based in Chicago, IL.

evidence.snippet: MaviGadget, 4610 N Clark St # 1039, Chicago, IL 60640-4620. Business Started: 12/22/2010. Incorporated: 5/13/2019. Type: LLC. Alternate Name: Brandimi LLC. Business Management: Mr. Ahmet Yanik, Principal.
evidence.supports: Operating location is Chicago, Illinois; legal entity is Brandimi LLC; principal is Ahmet Yanik.

evidence.snippet: Global rank #140. Country: United States. Within US: #33 most subscribed. Total views: 63B. Topics: Technology, Lifestyle. Snapshot Sep 2, 2026: 46,000,000 subscribers, 63,330,540,757 views, ranking #140.
evidence.supports: Ranking #33 in US per Communitrics snapshot dated Sep 2, 2026; country; topics/categories; lifetime views ~63B.

evidence.snippet: Rank 39: MaviGadget, Views: 57.9 billion, Content category: Technology, Country: United States, Primary language(s): English. As of June 2026.
evidence.supports: Primary language is English; content category classified as Technology; U.S.-based; ~57.9B lifetime views (Wikipedia metric, differs slightly from Communitrics).

evidence.snippet: MaviGadget operates less as a traditional creator channel and more as a scaled product-discovery media brand built around YouTube's short-form and compilation formats. ... catalogue-style publishing cadence with episode counts reaching into the thousands ... hand-picked curation ... two-sided marketplace ... brands, startups, and inventors to become partners ... sellers able to list and sell directly ... sequential numbering system that has surpassed entry number 3,000.
evidence.supports: Content supply model: curated two-sided marketplace with high-volume numbered Shorts; brands submit products; direct commerce integration.

evidence.snippet: MaviGadget was founded by Ahmet Yanik... We started in 2018 with one idea: build a home where brands and makers could put their most unique products in front of the right people... Building this since 2018, run from Chicago, shipping worldwide... We curate, and we're brutal about it... Brands bring us their products, we test them, and we list only the ones that earn a spot.
evidence.supports: Founding date (~2018 for platform; YouTube channel since Nov 2017), founder Ahmet Yanik, Chicago operations, curation-based supply model.

evidence.snippet: We collaborate directly with: Independent creators & inventors, Product labs, Kickstarter & Indiegogo brands, Shark Tank–featured companies, Design studios... Products come from creators, authorized labs, verified manufacturing partners... No — products are not dropshipped.
evidence.supports: Supply chain: global sourcing from creators, inventors, crowdfunding brands, Shark Tank companies, and product labs across U.S., Europe, South Korea, Japan, Turkey, China, Singapore.

evidence.snippet: Title: 'Patient Mobility Upgrades That Truly Work'. Uploaded Aug 28, 2024. 2,007,208 views. Channel: MaviGadget (46M subs).
evidence.supports: Representative work: top-performing long-form video with ~2M views on patient mobility/elderly care products.

evidence.snippet: Title: 'best kitchen sinks 2025'. Uploaded Oct 19, 2025. 953,320 views. Channel: MaviGadget (46M subs).
evidence.supports: Representative work: kitchen product roundup with ~953K views.

evidence.snippet: Title: 'how to protect yourself from dangerous people'. Uploaded Jun 9, 2024. 814,250 views. Channel: MaviGadget.
evidence.supports: Representative work: safety/self-defense product compilation with ~814K views.

evidence.snippet: Title: 'A Room So Silent You Can Hear Your Heartbeat!'. Uploaded Feb 11, 2026. 237,715 views. Channel: Mavigadget Originals (15.5K subs).
evidence.supports: Representative work from sister channel Mavigadget Originals: original experiential content about anechoic chambers.

evidence.snippet: Title: 'Product Link in Bio ( 302 ) Night Scape Outdoor Camping Light'. Uploaded Sep 12, 2023. 179,211 views. Channel: @MaviGadgets.
evidence.supports: Represents the signature numbered 'Product Link in Bio (#NNNN)' Shorts format used across thousands of uploads.

evidence.snippet: Tubefilter (Jun 3, 2024): 'MaviGadget brought the coolest gizmos to YouTube Shorts in May 2024.' Tubefilter (Feb 27, 2024): 'MaviGadget swept our Global and U.S. Top 50 charts... earning its second consecutive #1 finish after bringing in 711.8 million weekly views.'
evidence.supports: Content strategy pivot: became a dominant Shorts hub in early 2024, generating hundreds of millions of weekly views via Shorts format.
